name: HomeDojo Clinical Home Fall-Hazard Taxonomy
description: Original synthesis of visually detectable home fall hazards for older adults and post-op (THA/TKA) patients. Hazard concepts are cross-walked to validated instruments (CDC STEADI Check for Safety, HOME FAST, HSSAT, WeHSA, SAFER-HOME, Housing Enabler) but item wording here is original, not reproduced from copyrighted instruments. Not clinically validated; requires OT/PT review before use as ground truth.

severity_scale.high: Likely to cause a fall or injury during ordinary use, OR blocks a task the post-op discharge plan requires (e.g., walker cannot pass, no rail on stairs that must be used, toilet transfer impossible within hip precautions). Fix before discharge / first use.
severity_scale.medium: Raises fall likelihood in some conditions (night, wet, fatigue, carrying items) or requires a compensatory behavior; fix within days.
severity_scale.low: Minor contributor or easily avoided; fix opportunistically or via behavior/education.

post_op_escalation_rule: When the occupant uses a walker/crutches, has hip precautions, or is on restricted weight-bearing (NWB/TDWB/PWB), escalate severity one level for hazards whose post_op.escalate flag is true (max high).

door_clear_width_min_in.basis: ADA 2010 Standards 404.2.3 (accessibility design standard, not a clinical threshold)

hip_precautions_posterior.note: Many surgeons now use reduced or no precautions; always follow the individual discharge order.

instrument_keys.CDC: CDC STEADI 'Check for Safety' brochure (2017) sections: Stairs & Steps, Floors, Kitchen, Bedrooms, Bathrooms
instrument_keys.HOMEFAST: HOME FAST item number (1-25) per Mackenzie et al.; paraphrased topic only
instrument_keys.HSSAT: Home Safety Self-Assessment Tool v5 area (paraphrased)
instrument_keys.WeHSA: Westmead Home Safety Assessment section (section names partially verified)

hazards.name: No grab bar at tub/shower
hazards.visual_description: Tub or shower enclosure with no wall-mounted, load-rated grab bar on entry wall or back wall; bare tile/surround at hand height.
detection_cues: absence of horizontal/vertical bar 33-36 in above floor
only a soap dish, towel bar or door frame nearby

severity.low: Walk-in shower with bench and fixed support elsewhere within reach
severity.medium: Walk-in shower, no bar, occupant ambulatory without device
severity.high: Tub-shower combo requiring step-over with no bar, or any occupant using walker

post_op.walker: Walker cannot enter tub; transfer needs fixed support
post_op.hip_precautions: Step-over flexes hip; bar needed for controlled transfer
post_op.weight_bearing: NWB/TDWB cannot step over tub wall safely without bar + transfer bench

recommended_fix: Install wall-anchored grab bar(s) (entry vertical + back horizontal)
Clamp-on tub rail as temporary measure

hazards.name: No support at toilet
hazards.visual_description: Toilet with no grab bar, toilet safety frame, or sturdy fixed support within reach on either side.
detection_cues: toilet visible with bare adjacent wall/vanity

severity.low: Sturdy vanity edge within reach and occupant independent
severity.high: No support and occupant post-op, uses walker, or has hip precautions

post_op.walker: Walker is not a stable push-off for sit-to-stand on toilet
post_op.hip_precautions: Needs armrests to lower without flexing >90 degrees

recommended_fix: Toilet safety frame or raised seat with arms

hazards.name: Non-load-rated fixture positioned as support
hazards.visual_description: Towel bar, toilet-paper holder, soap dish, shower door handle, or glass door in the location a person would grab during a transfer, with no grab bar present.
detection_cues: glass shower door as only vertical surface

severity.low: Fixture present but a proper grab bar also within reach
severity.medium: Fixture is only thing within reach, occupant independent
severity.high: Fixture is only support and occupant uses walker / post-op

post_op.walker: Walker users reach for nearest fixed object
post_op.hip_precautions: Uncontrolled descent risks flexion >90 degrees
post_op.weight_bearing: Offloading onto fixture that fails -> fall onto operated side

recommended_fix: Remove suction-cup handles for load-bearing use

hazards.name: Slippery tub/shower floor
hazards.visual_description: Glossy tub or shower base with no non-slip mat, adhesive strips, or textured surface.
hazards.visual_detectability: partial (texture hard to judge in photos)

severity.medium: Smooth base, no strips, walk-in shower
severity.high: Smooth tub base with step-over, no strips

post_op.walker: Cannot use walker inside wet area
post_op.hip_precautions: Slip causes uncontrolled flexion/adduction
post_op.weight_bearing: Restricted-WB patient cannot recover balance on operated leg

hazards.name: High tub step-over without transfer aid
hazards.visual_description: Bathtub (or tub-shower combo) with side wall typically ~14-20 in high that must be stepped over to shower; no transfer bench or shower chair present.

severity.medium: Tub is only bathing option, occupant independent
severity.high: Tub is only bathing option and occupant post-op (hip/knee) or uses walker

post_op.walker: Walker cannot be used across tub wall
post_op.hip_precautions: Stepping over tub wall commonly exceeds 90 degree flexion
post_op.weight_bearing: Requires single-leg stance on one limb

hazards.name: Low toilet seat
hazards.visual_description: Standard-height toilet (about 15 in seat) with no raised seat, riser, or frame; seat noticeably below user knee height.
detection_cues: toilet bowl rim low relative to vanity/door handle
hazards.visual_detectability: partial (height estimation needs reference object or depth)

severity.medium: Standard low toilet, occupant not post-op
severity.high: Low toilet and occupant has hip precautions or post-TKA limited knee flexion

post_op.walker: Sit-to-stand from low seat is hardest transfer with walker
post_op.hip_precautions: Low seat forces hip flexion >90 degrees

recommended_fix: Raised toilet seat (3-4 in) with arms

hazards.name: Loose bath mat or rug on bathroom floor
hazards.visual_description: Fabric bath mat, towel, or small rug on hard/wet floor, without rubber backing; curled or bunched edges.

severity.low: Rubber-backed flat mat outside wet zone
severity.high: Curled/bunched mat in walker path or at shower exit

post_op.walker: Walker legs catch mat edges
post_op.hip_precautions: Trip leads to uncontrolled twisting

hazards.name: No shower seat or handheld shower
hazards.visual_description: Shower area with fixed overhead showerhead only and no shower chair/bench or built-in seat.
detection_cues: no chair or bench in enclosure

severity.low: Occupant can stand long periods and has grab bars
severity.medium: No seat, occupant has balance/endurance limits
severity.high: No seat and occupant post-op / uses walker

post_op.walker: Cannot stand unsupported for bathing
post_op.hip_precautions: Washing feet/legs while standing requires bending past 90 degrees

hazards.name: Bed height inappropriate
hazards.visual_description: Mattress top well below knee height (low platform/futon, deep soft mattress) or so high that feet cannot reach floor when seated.
detection_cues: very high bed with step stool

severity.medium: Clearly low or high, occupant not post-op
severity.high: Low bed with hip precautions, or high bed requiring hop-down

post_op.walker: Walker needs level stand-up from bed edge
post_op.hip_precautions: Hip must stay above knee when seated
post_op.weight_bearing: Hop-down from high bed loads operated leg

recommended_fix: Bed risers or remove box spring to target knee-height seat

hazards.name: No reachable bedside light
hazards.visual_description: No lamp or switch within arm's reach of the bed; nightstand absent or bare; wall switch only at door.

severity.low: Lamp present but awkward to reach
severity.medium: No bedside light, room has nightlight
severity.high: No bedside light and path to bathroom dark

post_op.walker: Getting up in dark while positioning walker
post_op.hip_precautions: Reaching across bed may rotate/adduct hip
post_op.weight_bearing: Nocturia + opioid use increases night risk

hazards.name: Dark bed-to-bathroom path
hazards.visual_description: Hallway/route from bed to toilet without nightlights or motion lighting; unlit hallway.
hazards.visual_detectability: partial (requires route context and/or night images)

severity.low: Short route with partial ambient light
severity.high: Unlit route with obstacles, level change, or rug

post_op.walker: Night trips with walker

recommended_fix: Plug-in or motion-sensor nightlights along route
Bedside commode for early post-op nights

hazards.name: Floor clutter around bed
hazards.visual_description: Clothes, shoes, bags, boxes, or laundry on floor beside bed or in the path to the door.
detection_cues: objects on floor within 3 ft of bed

severity.low: Small items against wall, not in path
severity.high: Items directly in stand-up zone or walker path

post_op.walker: Walker legs snag
post_op.hip_precautions: Picking items up requires bending past 90 degrees

recommended_fix: Clear floor; bins at waist height

hazards.name: Insufficient walker clearance around bed
hazards.visual_description: Bed pushed against wall or furniture leaving a narrow gap (less than about 30-36 in) on the exit side; no room to position a walker.
detection_cues: bed against wall on exit side
narrow gap between bed and furniture

severity.low: Gap tight but occupant not using device
severity.medium: Gap <36 in, device user can still pass
severity.high: Gap narrower than walker width

post_op.walker: Walker (24-26 in) plus feet needs ~30-36 in
post_op.hip_precautions: Exit on correct side may be dictated by surgery side

recommended_fix: Rearrange furniture for clear exit side
Move bed to first floor if needed

hazards.name: Missing handrail or rail on one side only
hazards.visual_description: Indoor staircase with no handrail, or a rail on only one side.
detection_cues: staircase with open or bare wall sides

severity.high: No rail, or one rail on the side opposite the stronger hand/unoperated leg for a post-op user

post_op.walker: Walker cannot be used on stairs; rail + cane/crutch technique required
post_op.weight_bearing: Restricted WB requires rail for step-to pattern ('up with good, down with bad')

recommended_fix: Install rails both sides, full length
Relocate bedroom to ground floor during recovery

hazards.name: Handrail loose, short, or not graspable
hazards.visual_description: Rail that stops before top/bottom step, is wobbly or detached, is a wide flat board, or is obstructed by objects.

severity.medium: Rail short by one or more steps
severity.high: Loose/broken or ungraspable rail on only rail

post_op.weight_bearing: Rail bears substantial load in restricted-WB stair climbing

hazards.name: Objects on stairs
hazards.visual_description: Shoes, papers, laundry baskets, books or other items resting on treads.

severity.low: Item against wall on wide stair
severity.high: Items on multiple treads or at top step

post_op.hip_precautions: Picking up requires bending

recommended_fix: Clear stairs; never store items on treads

hazards.name: Poor stair lighting
hazards.visual_description: Stairway without overhead light, burned-out bulb, or light switch only at one end.

severity.high: No working light on regularly used stairs

recommended_fix: Overhead light with switches at top and bottom

hazards.name: Undefined step edges / loose stair covering
hazards.visual_description: Patterned or same-color carpet hiding tread edges; loose, torn or worn carpet; no contrasting nosing strip.

severity.medium: Worn carpet or no edge marking on full flight
severity.high: Loose/torn carpet on tread

post_op.weight_bearing: Misjudged step loads operated leg suddenly

hazards.name: Broken or uneven steps
hazards.visual_description: Cracked, missing, sloped or inconsistent-height treads/risers.

severity.high: Broken/missing tread or large riser variation

hazards.name: Frequently used items stored high
hazards.visual_description: Everyday dishes, food, or cookware on upper shelves/cabinets above shoulder height; step stool nearby.

severity.high: Daily items high and step stool/chair used to reach

post_op.walker: Reaching overhead while holding walker destabilizes

recommended_fix: Move daily items to waist-to-shoulder height

hazards.name: Frequently used items stored low
hazards.visual_description: Daily-use pots, pet food, or supplies in floor-level cabinets, low drawers, or on the floor.
detection_cues: open base cabinets with daily items

severity.high: Daily items low and hip precautions active

post_op.hip_precautions: Retrieval requires hip flexion >90 degrees

hazards.name: Unstable step stool or chair used for reaching
hazards.visual_description: Step stool without handrail, folding stool, or kitchen chair positioned under upper cabinets.

severity.low: Sturdy stool with rail, stored away
severity.high: Chair or wobbly stool used as ladder

post_op.walker: Any climbing contraindicated early post-op
post_op.hip_precautions: Stepping up flexes hip

hazards.name: Slippery floor / loose mat at sink or stove
hazards.visual_description: Glossy floor, visible spills, or unbacked runner mat in front of sink/stove.

severity.high: Curled mat or visible wet floor in walker path

post_op.walker: Walker wheels/glides skid or catch

hazards.name: Throw rug / loose mat on walkway
hazards.visual_description: Area rug, runner, or throw rug with curled or lifted edges, no visible anchoring, on a common walking route.
detection_cues: rug on hard floor in path

severity.medium: Small unsecured rug off main path
severity.high: Curled/bunched rug on main route or at doorway

post_op.walker: Walker legs/wheels catch rug edges
post_op.hip_precautions: Trip-induced twist risks dislocation

hazards.name: Cords or wires across walkway
hazards.visual_description: Extension, lamp, phone, or charging cords crossing a floor path rather than routed along walls.
hazards.visual_detectability: full (thin cords may be small in frame)

severity.high: Cord crossing main route or doorway

post_op.walker: Wheels/legs catch cords

hazards.name: Cluttered or narrowed walking path
hazards.visual_description: Furniture, coffee tables, ottomans, boxes, or piles narrowing a route so the person must weave; items on floor.

severity.high: Path narrower than walker or objects underfoot

post_op.walker: Walker requires straight, clear path ~30-36 in
post_op.hip_precautions: Pivoting/twisting around obstacles risks rotation

hazards.name: Low or soft seating without armrests
hazards.visual_description: Deep sofa, recliner, or low chair without firm arms; seat well below knee height.

severity.high: Only low/soft seating and hip precautions or post-TKA

post_op.walker: Hard sit-to-stand with walker
post_op.hip_precautions: Low seat forces >90 degree flexion

recommended_fix: Firm chair with arms at knee height or higher

hazards.name: Poor lighting or glare
hazards.visual_description: Dim room, dark corners, bare bulbs causing glare, or strong window glare on glossy floor.

severity.high: Main route dark or glare obscures floor edges/level changes

hazards.name: Unmarked level change / step-down between rooms
hazards.visual_description: Sunken living room, single step between rooms, or raised floor transition strip without contrast or rail.
detection_cues: floor material change with height difference

severity.high: Single unmarked step on main route

post_op.walker: Walker must be lifted over step; front wheels catch

recommended_fix: Rail or grab pole at step

hazards.name: Pets and pet items underfoot
hazards.visual_description: Pet beds, bowls, toys, or the pet itself in walking routes.

severity.high: Items on main route or large active dog

post_op.walker: Pets tangle in walker
post_op.hip_precautions: Feeding pet at floor level requires bending

hazards.name: Exterior steps without handrail
hazards.visual_description: Porch or entry steps (one or more) without a handrail on either side.

severity.low: Single low step with door frame support
severity.high: 3+ steps, no rail, or occupant post-op

post_op.walker: Walker unusable on steps; entry is required at discharge

hazards.name: Raised threshold or door sill
hazards.visual_description: Raised door sill, sliding-door track, or shower curb at a doorway that must be stepped over.

severity.high: Sill >1 in or sliding track on required route

post_op.walker: Front wheels/legs catch

hazards.name: Uneven or damaged outdoor path
hazards.visual_description: Cracked, heaved, or sloped walkway; loose pavers; gravel; debris or leaves on path to door.

severity.high: Heaves/trip lips or slippery surface on only access route

post_op.walker: Walker wheels stick in gravel/cracks

hazards.name: Poor exterior lighting
hazards.visual_description: No porch light, burned-out fixture, or unlit steps/path to the door.

severity.high: Steps and path unlit on regular route

hazards.name: Doorway too narrow for walker
hazards.visual_description: Door opening (often bathroom or older interior doors, ~24-28 in) where clear width with door open is less than prescribed walker width plus hand clearance; door that cannot open fully.
hazards.visual_detectability: partial (requires width estimation; tape-measure photo recommended)

severity.medium: Clear width 28-32 in with walker 24-26 in
severity.high: Clear width < walker width + 2 in on required route (bathroom/bedroom/entry)

post_op.walker: Core walker clearance check (24-26 in walker; 32 in ADA door)
post_op.hip_precautions: Side-stepping through narrow door encourages twisting
post_op.weight_bearing: Leaving walker to pass through violates WB orders
